description: Synthetic lexical retrieval development/challenge suite; labels authored before ranking changes. Ambiguous queries accept multiple sources. No generated answers are evaluated.

documents.title: Privacy policy
documents.text: Personal data is deleted after account closure. Contact the privacy officer.

documents.title: Archived returns policy
documents.text: Returns were accepted within seven days.

documents.title: Shipping guide
documents.text: Standard delivery takes five business days. Express shipping takes two days.

documents.title: Current returns policy
documents.text: Returns are accepted within thirty days with a receipt.

documents.title: Merit scholarship
documents.text: Scholarship applications close on 15 December. Submit a transcript.

documents.title: Library loans
documents.text: Students may borrow six books. Library renewals are available online.

documents.title: Password reset
documents.text: Use the reset link to change a forgotten password. Links expire after one hour.

documents.title: Parking permits
documents.text: Parking permits cost twenty credits each term. Bicycles park free.

documents.title: Examination rules
documents.text: Bring a student identity card to the examination. Calculators are allowed only where stated.

documents.title: Laboratory safety
documents.text: Wear goggles in the laboratory. Report chemical spills to the supervisor.

documents.title: Medical leave
documents.text: Medical leave requires a certificate. Submit it within three days.

documents.title: Tuition payment
documents.text: Tuition payment deadlines are published each term. Installments require approval.
